subject: general
question: The 'United Nations' theme for observance of Women's Day 2022 was ______.

options.text: Think Equal, Build Smart, Innovate for Change
Gender Equality Today for a Sustainable Tomorrow
Women in Leadership: Achieving an Equal Future in a Covid-19 World
An Equal World is an Enabled World

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gender Equality Today for a Sustainable Tomorrow**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The United Nations theme for International Women's Day in 2022 was **"Gender equality today for a sustainable tomorrow".**
 
• This **theme recognized the contributions of women and girls around the world in addressing climate change**. 
 
• The campaign theme f**or International Women's Day 2022 was #BreakTheBias.**
 
• The International Women's Day website asked people to imagine a world free of bias, stereotypes, and discrimination. 
 
• International Women's Day (IWD) is a worldwide event celebrating women's cultural, political, and economic achievements.
 
• Every year on March 8th, it is commemorated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• IWD arose from early twentieth-century labour movements in North America and Europe.
 
• The first edition was supposedly a "Women's Day" organized by the Socialist Party of America on February 28, 1909, in New York City.
 
• International Women's Day is celebrated in a number of forms around the world, in certain nations, it is a public holiday, and it is observed socially or politically.
 
• International Women's Day is celebrated in a number of ways around the world; in some nations, it is a national holiday, whereas, in others, it is observed socially or locally.
 
• The UN commemorates the holiday in celebration of a specific topic, movement, or theme related to women's rights.
